pr.body:
## Summary

A behavior-preserving cleanup pass over all four crates: magic numbers named, copy-pasted blocks folded into helpers, and a handful of idiom fixes (`&String`/`&Option<String>` params, `bool` args → enums, `match`-on-`Option` → `map_or`, `.unwrap()` in row mappers → `?`). Every refactor was gated on a test: where one already covered the code it was named and run first; where none did, a pinning test was written against the *old* code and run green before the change. Net: **+20 tests** (710 across the workspace), **0 clippy warnings** workspace-wide (was 7), `cargo fmt --check` clean.

One commit per area so each is reviewable on its own:

| Commit | What |
|---|---|
| `nebula-core` | New `nebula_core::env`: every `NEBULA_*` variable name as a const, plus `non_empty()` and `home_dir()`, used by the daemon, TUI, CLI, hook installer and the e2e tests instead of string literals (a typo now fails to build instead of silently falling back to a default). `paths.rs` uses it and one `project_dirs()`. `codec.rs` has one `check_len()`/`invalid_data()` instead of two frame-too-large blocks. `crashlog.rs` gets `SECS_PER_*` and a testable `format_timestamp`. |
| `nebula` CLI | `KILL_HINT` shared by `upgrade.rs` and `main.rs` (the two copies had drifted: "all" vs "ALL"); one `init_file_logging()` for daemon and TUI; `log_fatal(&Path)`, `spawn_ttyd(&OsStr)`. |
| e2e tests | `make_executable()` replaces 12 chmod blocks, `subscribe()` 8 subscribe-and-wait blocks, `agent_cli()` 4 CLI spawns, `make_repo` delegates to `make_repo_at`; 120 bare `Duration` literals and the escape-byte sends become named consts. |
| `nebula-tui` (non-event-loop) | `modal_block`/`render_modal_frame` (6 byte-identical sites), `empty_list_row`, `below_first_row`, `visible_positions`, `hint_line`; popup sizes named. `window_start`/`clamp_selection`/`max_scroll`/`clamp_files_width` shared by 6/5/2/2 impls. One `truncate` (was also `grep_search::clip`), one `cap_lines`. `ipc.rs`: `await_ack`, `current_agent_id`, `RenameMode`. `pull_request.rs`: one `gh()` wrapper and `str_at`/`arr_at`/`web_url` extractors; `STATE_OPEN`. `keymap.rs`: one `KEY_NAMES` table backs `parse_key_name`/`key_name`/`key_display` (pinned first by a test asserting every current spelling and glyph); `CTRL_COLLISIONS`; `UNBOUND`. `config.rs`: `DEFAULT_CHOICE`. |
| `nebula-daemon` | `DEFAULT_COLS/ROWS` (9 × `80, 24`), `broadcast_agent`/`try_broadcast_agent` (15 sites), `kill_sessions_in`, `LOGIN_SHELL_ARGS`, `CLI_PROBE_TIMEOUT`; `AGENT_SESSION_VARS` replaces the per-spawn `scrubbed_env_names()` allocation. `store.rs`: one `*_COLUMNS` const + `row_to_*` mapper per entity shared by point lookups and `load_tree` (the point lookups' ~41 `.unwrap()`s now propagate via `?`), `delete_by_id`, `DEFAULT_WORKSPACE_ID` bound instead of an inlined `'default'`. `status.rs`: `end_turn` shared by `Stop` and `Progress{busy:false}`. `hooks/installer.rs`: `install_claude_hooks` reuses `install_managed_hooks`, `root_object_mut`/`object_mut`/`array_mut` replace 9 bail blocks (messages verbatim), `purge_nebula_groups`, `HOOKS_FILE`/dir consts, shared curl prelude (pinned verbatim by a new test). `hooks/mod.rs`: `HookDialect` enum for the `bool`, `HOOK_OK`/`HOOK_NOT_OK`, handlers moved above the test module. `lib.rs`: `env_period_ms` (tested) + `env_interval`. `server.rs`: `reply_done` for 21 arms. `pty`: `pty_size`, `ESC`/`BEL`. `git.rs`: `parse_worktree_list` is a pure, tested function. |
| `event_loop.rs` | `contains()` for 10 open-coded rect tests; `selected_checkout` + `load_worktree_files` (4 modal preambles); `spawn_editor_modal` (4); `settings`/`settings_mut` (17); `send`/`send_with` (~24 `alloc_req_id` + push pairs); `upsert_by`; `worktree_in_context`; `select_project_row`/`select_worktree_row` shared by key and mouse; `is_double_click`; `leave_terminal_lock`; `bracketed()` + `PASTE_START/END`; `edit_keymap`; `confirm_delete_agent`/`confirm_close_terminal`/`confirm_remove_project` shared by key and menu (pinned by a new test); `MenuItem::new`/`destructive` for 46 literals; `Landing` enum for `jump_to_target`'s `bool`; `next_focus` behind the three focus-walk tables; `home_dir`; `step_selection`; `clamp_index`; wheel-step, restore-clamp, anchor and fallback-pane consts. |

### Deliberately not done (medium risk, untested draw paths)
- Folding the six list-modal mouse arms / four overlay key handlers in `event_loop.rs` into one — arm order is load-bearing for Tree.
- `jump_to_target` vs `open_session` (~45 near-identical lines) — the non-attach path has extra `preview_selected` bookkeeping.
- The two-pane modal scaffold in `ui.rs` (Diff vs Tree, ~120 lines) — no test covers the Tree arm.
- A `str_enum!` macro for `AgentStatus`/`AgentKind` — a typo there is a silent persistence break.
- `Config::write_into`/`value_label`/`cycle` table-driving — serde field-name drift hazard.

A `/code-review` pass over the branch (no high-severity findings) fed a final commit: the agents' overlapping helpers were reconciled (`step_selection`/`clamp_index` → `app::clamp_selection`, `home_dir` → `nebula_core::env::home_dir`, `pr_preview::fit` → `truncate`, `grep_search` → `git_diff::run_git`, hit-testing → ratatui's `Rect::contains`), `PROJECT_COLUMNS` no longer hides a positional `?1` bind (the default workspace is applied in `row_to_project`), `remove_project` loads the tree once again, `RenameMode` is built where `--force` is parsed, and the `paths.rs` env test restores its vars on drop.

### Small semantic deltas worth knowing
- `store.rs` point lookups return `Err` on a corrupt row instead of panicking the daemon thread.
- `nebula stale-daemon-note` now prints "(stops all sessions)" like the two `upgrade` sites did, not "ALL" — the three copies had drifted and `KILL_HINT` picked the majority.
- The metrics modal's `k`/wheel-up now clamps to the last row (it was an unclamped `saturating_sub`); identical while the cursor is in range.
- `~/` expansion everywhere goes through `home_dir()` (`var_os`), so a non-UTF-8 `$HOME` now expands where `ipc::add_project` used to fall through.

## Test plan
- [x] `cargo fmt --all --check`
- [x] `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets` — 0 warnings
- [x] `cargo test --workspace --no-fail-fast` — 709 passed, 0 failed (incl. `e2e_pty` 25/25, `e2e_tui` 5/5)
- [x] Every new helper's pinning test was run green against the pre-refactor code first

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

commits.messageBody:
Pure refactor, no behavior change (467 tests, was 458; e2e_tui 5/5; clippy
clean outside event_loop.rs). What was folded together:

ui.rs
- modal_block / render_modal_frame for the six accent+BOLD modal frames
  (Settings, Memory, Palette, Files, Grep, Hosts)
- below_first_row, empty_list_row + NO_MATCHES across the five filtered lists
- visible_positions for the ellipsis-aware fuzzy highlight clip (x3)
- hint_line for the three empty-panel nudges
- named popup sizes beside VIM_MODAL_PCT; SPLIT_PANE_LAYOUT_MIN documents
  why the Min(20) sits below MIN_DIFF_PANE_W
- truncate is pub; grep_search::clip removed in its favor

app.rs / tree_browser.rs / git_diff.rs
- free window_start, clamp_selection, max_scroll, scrolled_by,
  clamp_files_width shared by DiffView, Palette, FileFinder, GrepView,
  HostsView and TreeBrowser
- cap_lines + TRUNCATED_MARK shared by the diff pane and the tree preview

ipc.rs / lib.rs
- agent_id_from / current_agent_id for the NEBULA_AGENT_ID guard
- await_reply / await_ack for the three Ack-or-Error loops
- RenameMode { Auto, Force } replaces the bool (lib.rs converts at the CLI
  boundary); rename/add_project take &str
- ONE_SHOT_REQ_ID, CLOSED_BEFORE_REPLY, POLL_STEP

pull_request.rs / pr_preview.rs
- one gh(dir, args, timeout) wrapper for the five process spawns
- str_at / u64_at / bool_at / arr_at / state_at / web_url replace the
  per-parser closures; STATE_OPEN + state_is_open; unseen uses map_or
- MIN_BODY_W names the bare .max(20)

config.rs
- DEFAULT_CHOICE sentinel; struct-update syntax in the save test (clippy)

keymap.rs
- KEY_NAMES table behind parse_key_name / key_name / key_display, pinned
  first by named_keys_keep_their_spellings_and_glyphs
- CTRL_COLLISIONS table in host_warning; UNBOUND; map_or in chords/label

Skipped: bind(.., add: bool) -> enum, since event_loop.rs calls it.

Zero-behavior-change cleanup of crates/nebula-daemon, one item per hunk:

registry.rs
- pty::DEFAULT_COLS/DEFAULT_ROWS replace the nine literal `80, 24` headless spawns
- broadcast_agent / try_broadcast_agent replace 15 copies of
  `agent_entity(id)? + broadcast(EntityUpserted)` (5 of them if-let-Ok variants)
- kill_sessions_in shares the kill-agents-and-terminals-then-kill_prewarmed_in
  sequence between remove_project and delete_worktree
- take_prewarmed takes Option<&str> for model/effort
- the spawn-args builder pushes the shared `--model` flag once (argv byte-identical)
- nebula_core::env consts for the agent PTY env vec, and AGENT_SESSION_VARS
  replaces the per-spawn scrubbed_env_names() allocation
- LOGIN_SHELL_ARGS shared by the CLI probe and login_shell_wrap; CLI_PROBE_TIMEOUT,
  AGENT_CMD and CLOUD_MIRROR_SECS name the remaining env/timeout literals

store.rs
- one *_COLUMNS const and row_to_* mapper per entity (workspace, project, worktree,
  agent, terminal, link), shared by the point lookups and load_tree; the ~40
  `.unwrap()`s in the point lookups now propagate with `?`
- delete_by_id behind the six `DELETE FROM <table> WHERE id = ?1` bodies
- the default workspace id is bound from DEFAULT_WORKSPACE_ID instead of an
  inlined 'default' literal in two SELECTs

status.rs
- end_turn shares the end-of-turn bookkeeping between Stop and Progress{busy:false}

hooks/installer.rs
- install_claude_hooks reuses install_managed_hooks (new allow_rules param)
- root_object_mut / object_mut / array_mut replace nine let-else bail blocks,
  messages kept verbatim
- purge_nebula_groups shared by the codex prune and the cursor install
- HOOKS_FILE, CLAUDE_SETTINGS_FILE, CLAUDE_DIR/CURSOR_DIR/CODEX_DIR,
  HOOK_CURL_TIMEOUT_SECS; env_guard + hook_curl share the curl prelude between
  the claude/codex and cursor command builders (pinned verbatim by a new test)

hooks/mod.rs
- HookDialect { Injectable, Plain } replaces the inject_capable bool
- HOOK_OK / HOOK_NOT_OK consts
- handlers moved above the test module (clears clippy items_after_test_module)

lib.rs
- env_period_ms + env_interval share the env-tunable interval loop (unit-tested),
  MIN_TICK_MS, IDLE_REAP_MS / WORKTREE_SYNC_MS consts

server.rs
- reply_done for the 21 `reply(.., x.map(|_| None))` arms

pty/mod.rs, pty/progress.rs, pty/kitty.rs
- pty_size for the four PtySize literals; SpawnSpec::scrub_env is now a
  &'static [&'static str]; ESC / BEL name the scanner bytes

git.rs
- parse_worktree_list is a pure function (unit-tested against porcelain output)
  with one shared stanza close instead of two push sites

commits.messageBody:
No behavior change; every fold is pinned by the existing unit tests plus
two written first for the unpinned spots (menu-path confirm copy, and the
bracketed paste sent to a locked pane).

Duplicate blocks folded:
- rect hit-testing in handle_mouse            -> contains()
- selected-worktree preamble in the 4 file modals -> selected_checkout(),
  plus load_worktree_files() for the finder/tree pair
- the 4 editor-spawn blocks                   -> spawn_editor_modal()
- `Overlay::Settings(view)` unwraps           -> settings()/settings_mut()
- alloc_req_id + push                         -> send()/send_with()
- apply_upsert find-or-push                   -> upsert_by()
- worktree-or-root-checkout rule              -> worktree_in_context()
- click-to-select vs move_selection arms      -> select_project_row()/
                                                 select_worktree_row()
- double-click detection x3                   -> is_double_click()
- escape-hatch unlock x2                      -> leave_terminal_lock()
- bracketed paste x2                          -> bracketed() + PASTE_*
- clone/mutate/save_keymap x3                 -> edit_keymap(), save_config()
- key-vs-menu confirm dialogs                 -> confirm_delete_agent(),
                                                 confirm_close_terminal(),
                                                 confirm_remove_project()
- detach + delete/close request pairs         -> delete_agent(),
                                                 close_terminal(),
                                                 delete_worktree(),
                                                 create_terminal()

Literals named: MODAL_WHEEL_LINES, TERM_WHEEL_LINES (arrow burst now built
by repetition), MAX_RESTORED_WIDTH, MIN_PANE_DIM (+ pane_usable()),
FALLBACK_PANE, KEYBOARD_MENU_ANCHOR, SELECT_CONTEXT_FIRST, SESSION_GONE,
AGENT_ARCHIVED; the four HOME reads go through home_dir(); MenuItem
literals use the new MenuItem::new / MenuItem::destructive (app.rs).

Idioms: jump_to_target takes `Landing::{Attach, FocusOnly}` instead of a
bool; open_menu_at removed; move_selection matches focus once;
next_focus() backs FocusNext/FocusTerminal/FocusRight; unwrap_or_else /
if-let in note_open_prs_answer and select_link_by_id; resolve_file_link
borrows its candidates; open_prompt uses Cow locals; clamp_index() and
step_selection() replace the hand-rolled clamps; the pbcopy
needless_return is gone.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
commits.messageHeadline: Dedupe event_loop.rs: shared helpers, named consts, idiom cleanups

commits.messageBody:
… env consts

- nebula_core::env now carries every NEBULA_* name (AGENT_CMD, IDLE_REAP_MS,
  WORKTREE_SYNC_MS, CLOUD_MIRROR_SECS, LOG, INSTALL_URL, EDITOR) plus
  home_dir(); the per-crate private consts and the e2e tests' string
  literals use it
- store.rs: PROJECT_COLUMNS selects bare workspace_id and row_to_project
  applies DEFAULT_WORKSPACE_ID, instead of a COALESCE(.., ?1) that made
  every query bind a hidden first parameter
- registry.rs: kill_sessions_in takes the rows remove_project already
  loaded, so it no longer reads the tree twice
- event_loop.rs: step_selection/clamp_index replaced by app::clamp_selection,
  hit-testing by ratatui's Rect::contains (with the dead width > 0 guards
  dropped), the local home_dir by nebula_core::env::home_dir; the
  misplaced doc comment is back on enter_terminal_pane
- pr_preview::fit uses ui::truncate; grep_search uses git_diff::run_git
- RenameMode is built in main.rs where --force is parsed and re-exported
  from nebula_tui
- paths.rs env test restores NEBULA_RUNTIME_DIR/DATA_DIR on drop, so a
  failed assertion can't leak the override into a later test
- e2e_pty.rs: TestEnv::cli() base builder behind the daemon spawns,
  run_cli, run_upgrade and agent_cli; spawn_daemon_with_shell shares
  spawn_daemon_in; e2e_tui.rs names its 5s/50ms
